description: Safety NLP release manifest. Records which optional models the Safety-Override shadow pipeline may load, and under what approvals. Checked in deliberately: it is a governance record, not a build artifact. The ner/assertion/similarity entries are downloaded at `docker build` time by app/safety_nlp/prefetch.py at the pinned revision and checked against artifactSha256 (sha256 of model.safetensors); the runtime loads them local-files-only.

clinical.notes: The model card declares no license. Shadow telemetry only; confirm terms before any activation beyond shadow.

biolord.notes: License review pending (UMLS/SNOMED-derived training data); see similarity.BIOLORD_LICENSE_REVIEW_STATUS.

mdebertaNli.notes: Direct multilingual NLI comparator for the category stage (CAREROUTE_SAFETY_NLP_DIRECT_NLI). Fetched only with the WITH_SAFETY_NLP_DIRECT_NLI=1 build arg; ~558 MB fp16 safetensors.

nllb.notes: CC-BY-NC-4.0 is non-commercial/research-only for this project. Production or additive activation requires explicit license AND governance approval; validate_safety_model_manifest() enforces this.
